title: Standing Wave
body: A string is fixed at both ends to supports $$3.50\, \text{m}$$ apart and has a linear mass density of $$mu=\$\$0.005\, \tfrac{\text{kg}}{\text{m}}$$. The string is under a tension of $$90.00\, \text{N}$$. $$A$$ $$standing$$ $$wave$$ $$is$$ $$produced$$ $$on$$ $$the$$ $$string$$ $$with$$ $$six$$ $$nodes$$ $$and$$ $$five$$ $$antinodes$$.
